# `inconsistent-parameter-vocabulary`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: none · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports a parameter name that differs from the dominant name used for the same
spelled type across the project.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Giving one recurring concept one word improves calls, review, and project-wide
search.

## When it fires

A type needs at least 20 samples and a 90% name majority. Unresolved or
structurally different type spellings are not merged. A parameter is not
reported when it cannot take the majority name: another parameter of the
function has the same type, or the name is already declared where the
parameter is visible (the function itself, a container member, a parameter,
local or capture of the function), which Zig rejects as shadowing.
